This Order m ay be cited as the Customs (ASEAN Common E ffe ctive Preferential Tariff) Order, 1999 and shall be deemed to have commenced on lst. January, 1999 ·
Fo r the purpose of section 8 of the Act, all member countries of the Association Of South East Asian Nations are hereby specified as prescribed countries.

Notwithstanding anything contained in the Customs lmport Duties Order, 1973 , there shall be levied in respect of the imported goods specified in the Schedule which ar e shown to the satisfaction Of the Controller to have originated from and to have been consigned direct from a member country Of the Association Of South East Asian Nations customs duties at the rates and in respect Of the ye ar s specified in the Schedule.

For the purpose of paragraph 3 , goods shall be deemed to have originated from an d to have been consigned direct from such a member country where they conform with the Rules of Origin annexed to the Agreement on ASEAN Common Effective Preferential Tariff (CEPT) Scheme for the ASEAN Free Trade Area (AFTA).

The Customs (ASEAN Common Effective Preferential Tariff) Order, 1994 is repealed. 1637 Citation and Commence, ment. Prescription of prescribed countries. Preferential rates of customs duties. s34 / 73 · Schedule. Deemed country of origi n Of goods. Repeal of S6 / 96 ·
